body:
Per the owner decision of 2026-10-06, a card pinned to Focus is now deleted in one confirmed step and leaves Focus with its source. Fixed in 8428016 and running in the existing HTTPS app; ADR-069 records the rule.

The full local gate and the deletion/Focus browser suites pass in Chromium and WebKit. No physical iPhone was used. Evidence: progress/2026-10-06-pinned-card-deletion.md.

metadata.summary: Pinned cards are deleted in one step
